about_the_game:
Add CA2S: The Speed Rumbler to your Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium game line-up!

It's the beginning of the 21st century, and the notorious terrorist group known as Zapper has kidnapped the people of a peaceful town.
Super Joe, a soldier in the Special Forces, must embark on a mission to rescue his family.
Hit the road in your armored vehicle and plough through the enemy forces to save your family and friends!

Players: 1-2 Player Tag Team
Genre: Shooter
Versions: Japanese & English
